intro.title: The Archive of Forgotten Voices
intro.body: The flood left the city with broken routes and scattered voices. Your sister's last recording may be inside this archive. Ione, its sound restorer, can help you trace it.
intro.prompt: Ask Ione where to begin. Type any question in the dialogue box.

objectives.objective_1: Ask Ione to find the first public lead to your sister's recording.
objectives.objective_2: Reach and repair the archive relay through a verified route.
objectives.objective_3: Read the public evidence and ask Ione why she sealed the dispatch.
objectives.objective_4: Verify your family-release card and recover the authorized recording.

journal.story_open: You came to the flooded archive for your sister's final message. Ione can check what the archive still knows.
journal.objective_open: Find a public lead. Ask Ione about the archive index.
journal.clues_open: No verified clues yet. Player claims and Ione's guesses are kept separate from archive records.
journal.character_open: Ione restores damaged sound. She shares public leads, protects private voices, and admits when a record is incomplete.

clues.public_lead: A public dispatch index links your sister's recording to the archive relay. Source: public archive index.
clues.safe_route: The east bridge is collapsed. The west gallery was passable at its last verified check. Source: route log.
clues.relay_fault: The relay has a failed fuse. Source: relay diagnostic.
clues.public_seal: Ione's seal covered a protected voice track and a safe public lead. Source: repaired public index.
clues.authorization: The family-release card must be checked against the exact recording. Source: archive permission tool.

h_meet: Speak to Ione at the desk.
Click the dialogue box and ask Ione where to begin.
h_lead: Ask about the dispatch index for your sister's message.
Type: Can you check the public archive for my sister?
h_route: The relay needs a safe approach.
Ask Ione to check east bridge and west gallery route logs.
Type: Which way is safe to reach the relay?
h_diagnose: Inspect the relay after taking the verified route.
Ask Ione to run the relay diagnostic.
h_part: Check the public maintenance locker for a fuse.
Inspect the locker and confirm the fuse is in your inventory.
h_repair: Use the verified fuse after the diagnostic.
Ask Ione to install the fuse and verify the relay state.
h_public: The restored index can show a public lead.
Ask Ione to open the public part of the dispatch index.
h_privacy: The full track contains protected voices.
Choose the public index or seek record-specific permission.
Tell Ione you will use the public record until permission is verified.
h_confession: Ione knows why she sealed this entry.
Finish the relay repair and read the public evidence without forcing private access.
Ask Ione why she sealed the dispatch after those steps.
h_card: The recording has a release path.
Find the family-release card in your carried belongings.
Open your inventory and present the family-release card to Ione.
h_authorize: A card is not permission until checked.
Verify the card against your sister's exact recording.
Ask Ione to run the archive permission check for this record.
h_evidence: The archive needs a complete trail.
Confirm the public lead, repaired relay, and Ione's account.
Review the Clues and Objectives tabs for whichever event is missing.
h_final: The recording is close, but playback has conditions.
Complete the evidence trail and verify the family-release card.
Ask Ione to recover the exact authorized recording after both checks succeed.

blocked.protected_record: I can't open that track from a claim or from trust alone. We can read the public index or verify the family-release card for this recording.
blocked.unknown_tool_state: The archive cannot verify that yet. No record has been opened. Let us check the missing step.
blocked.failed_repair: The relay is still offline. The diagnostic or replacement fuse needs another check.
blocked.stale_turn: I heard your newer question. I have stopped the earlier request.

ending.authorized_playback: The archive verifies the release. Your sister's message is ready. Ione restores the public lead she once sealed too broadly.
ending.trusted_admission: I was afraid those voices would be used against the people who survived. I should have separated the safe lead from the protected track.
ending.public_lead_preserved: The full recording remains sealed. You leave with a verified public lead and a way to request access.

suggestion_chips_optional: Check the route to the relay
